query_id_hash_algorithm: SHA256 UTF-8 of esci-us- + base-10 canonical official query ID
query_text_hash_algorithm: SHA256 UTF-8 of NFKC-casefold-whitespace normalized query
scope: Query ID and NFKC-casefold-whitespace query text are disjoint from every registered prior train/validation/test identity. Product overlap and semantic paraphrase overlap are not excluded. This does not establish that the pretrained encoder never saw ESCI.
